entries.given: Valid Engineering-notation Source
entries.when: the compiler parses and validates it
then: an error-free versioned serializable Document is produced

entries.given: Source with invalid regions
then: valid regions recover into the Document
errors prevent AzeDocument and Artifact production

entries.given: Source with metadata, version, or unknown-directive failures
then: each Diagnostic carries the correct SourceRange and lists alternatives

entries.given: Two Sources differing only in trivia, paths, diagnostics, ranges, or render options
then: both contentHashes are equal

entries.given: A failing compilation
entries.when: an author reads the human Diagnostic report
then: every Diagnostic is line-specific and author-facing

entries.given: A failing compilation
entries.when: a tool reads the JSON Diagnostic report
then: stable code, data, range, order, and fix semantics are preserved

entries.given: Malformed input or a component fault
then: the fault is bounded, redacted, and contained without crashing

entries.given: The built-in registry, schemas, versions, and capabilities
then: construction is deterministic
ambiguous registrations are rejected with a stable error

entries.given: A Plugin, Block renderer, or Renderer fault
then: partial Artifacts are discarded
ordered Diagnostics are preserved

entries.given: A Source render
then: success atomically commits exactly one requested Artifact
failure preserves the prior Artifact

entries.given: Stdin, stdout, format, and destination modes
then: behavior matches the CLI contract including binary-terminal denial

entries.given: Validate and format commands
then: each executes only its specified layers and write modes

entries.given: A watched Source with discovered and missing dependencies
then: rebuilds serialize
failure preserves the prior Artifact

entries.given: A served Source
then: the server is loopback-only and constrained
it exposes current Diagnostics rather than stale content

entries.given: Every CLI command
then: exit codes, stdout purity, finite JSON, NDJSON lifecycle, quiet mode, and signal cleanup match the CLI contract

entries.given: Capability and version reports
then: they are complete, deterministic, local-only, and truthful

entries.given: Readable equation Blocks
then: HTML carries visual plus MathML pairs and visual Artifacts stay consistent

entries.given: Invalid equations and raw LaTeX
then: invalid equations diagnose precisely
raw LaTeX is denied by default and bounded when explicitly trusted

entries.given: A Mermaid Block
then: the SVG is deterministic, sanitized, and accessible
active or invalid content fails safely

entries.given: The Golden report under all three Themes
entries.when: it renders to HTML, SVG, PNG, and PDF
then: every semantic object is present with format-appropriate proof

entries.given: Every rendered Artifact
entries.when: its bytes and manifest are inspected
then: it is self-contained, profile/MIME/geometry-correct, and truthfully hashed

entries.given: Pagination boundary fixtures
then: every keep, split, scaling, and oversize-error rule holds

entries.given: Reference fixtures compiled twice in fresh directories under one fingerprint
then: contentHash, assetManifestHash, renderer fingerprint, Artifact bytes, and artifactHash are equal
trivia and path moves preserve identity while semantic, Theme, asset, and dependency changes invalidate only the specified identities

entries.given: A missing browser or format adapter
then: a structured remedy is reported
unaffected formats remain usable

entries.given: Traversal and symlink escapes
then: the root confinement rejects them without leaking host paths

entries.given: An offline compilation
then: no non-loopback request or external name resolution occurs

entries.given: Raw or embedded active content, unsafe protocols, malformed assets, and unsafe sanitizer rewrites
then: each is rejected

entries.given: Capability, time, memory, Diagnostic, asset, temp, and Artifact bounds
then: compilation fails closed without partial Artifacts

entries.given: Supported Node and OS combinations
then: all pass and system fonts, locales, and timezones do not alter Artifact eligibility

entries.given: A temporary copy of the Golden report
entries.when: the modify-equation and table-value loop runs
then: edits change content and Artifact identities while presence checks still pass
the missing-dx step fails line-specifically without committing an Artifact
restoration passes

entries.given: Five approved Circuit Sources
then: each matches its exact semantic oracle and content hash

entries.given: The closed component, value, and annotation union
then: every member passes

entries.given: Unknown, duplicate, terminal, quantity, limit, and convention failures
then: stable typed ranged Diagnostics are emitted

entries.given: Unused nodes and disconnected residual subgraphs
then: each warns without cascades

entries.given: Circuit topology
then: only explicit terminal-node relations create connectivity

entries.given: Directional hints, limits, labels, reference ground, and unsupported layout
then: behavior matches the Circuit contract

entries.given: Five Circuits under the required convention and Theme matrix
then: every cell passes

entries.given: Five Circuits embedded through four formats
then: labels stay legible after semantic connectivity passes

entries.given: Canonical Circuit SVG bytes across claimed pilot platforms
then: bytes match under the pinned closure

entries.given: The selected Circuit adapter
then: restricted execution, cleanup, timeout, budget, and availability all pass

entries.given: Missing, disabled, or incompatible engines
then: a structured exact remedy is reported
non-Circuit Documents never probe the adapter

entries.given: Every supported-pilot-platform manifest row
then: every row passes

entries.given: Five lecturer-reviewed Source and semantic pairs
then: they freeze Circuit body syntax 1.0.0 as the conformance corpus

entries.given: The five-fixture set with immutable evidence
then: two lecturers approve the set
one course owner approves usefulness and convention
